title: Privacy versus the public's right to know
news: News publishers have challenged the data protection law for requiring a person's consent before journalists process their data.
syllabus: Information sharing and transparency in government · Ethical issues in media
link: Respect for individual privacy must be weighed against the public's right to know about matters of public interest.
question: As an editor, you hold verified evidence of a senior official's misuse of public funds, but he invokes his privacy and refuses consent. What will you do and why?

title: AI, layoffs and an ethical work culture
news: Microsoft offered 'voluntary' exits to 60,000 staff; TCS cut about 12,000 jobs in 2025, mainly middle and senior managers, as AI reshapes work.
syllabus: Work culture · Ethical concerns and dilemmas in private institutions
link: Technological disruption tests whether firms act with honesty, fairness and care for workers' livelihoods and mental health.
question: As HR head of an IT firm adopting AI, you must cut 20% of staff. How will you manage the transition ethically, keeping in mind employees' livelihoods and mental health?
